messages:
auditor_bot: Hi team — can you provide the KMS/HSM access logs and key rotation evidence for key alias redwood-prod/ingest-key for the window 2025-11-02 00:00 UTC to 2025-11-04 23:59 UTC? Auditor requests chain of custody, rotation records, and access principals.

maria (SecEng): Ack, grabbing. quick Q: do you need raw CloudTrail entries or the curated evidence bundle?

auditor_bot: Curated bundle preferred, but include raw entries for any anomalous accesses. We also want the repro steps for the incident on 2025-11-03 14:12 UTC where a customer reported 401s and failed decrypts.

sam (Support): FYI that incident was flagged as INC-2025-467. initial triage: spike in auth errors -> upstream KMS timeout. I'll attach the incident timeline and request IDs.

jess (PlatformOps): Pulling CloudTrail + HSM audit logs now. I have the query that pulls the KMS Decrypt/Encrypt/GenerateDataKey calls and HSM sessions: 

```
# AWS CloudTrail quick query (CloudWatch Logs Insights)
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId, responseElements
| filter (eventName in ["Decrypt","Encrypt","GenerateDataKey"]) and requestParameters.keyId like /ingest-key/
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000
```

jess (PlatformOps): Also running an HSM session extract from the on-prem HSM log store; will redact IPs and link to the evidence bucket.

maria (SecEng): Note: key rotation for that alias occurred on 2025-10-28 (automated rotation). Rotation metadata + KMS rewrap events are in our key-management service. Confirming rotation policy and KMS CMK IDs.

taylor (Compliance): For SOC 2 evidence pack: we need rotation proof (signed rotation event), KMS key policy snapshot during the window, access control list, and sampling methodology for access log export. Auditor asked specifically for how you sampled logs for the provided bundle.

sam (Support): I can draft the incident repro steps we used against a staging customer dataset: 
1) Recreate request with same client token and headers.
2) Send decrypt call to KMS endpoint in region us-west-2 with same ciphertext blob.
3) Observe 504/timeout pattern; retry behavior triggered by SDK.

sam (Support): I have the request IDs: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c9f, r-0a1b2cfa — these map to the CloudTrail entries jess is extracting.

jess (PlatformOps): Evidence bundle draft uploaded: https://evidence.internal.redwood/cases/INC-2025-467/kms-hsm-bundle-20251103.tar.gz : includes raw cloudtrail.json (redacted), curated csv of events, rotation manifest, and HSM session excerpts.

auditor_bot: Thanks. Please confirm retention policy for these logs and the retention timestamps in our environment. Auditor will need evidence that logs were kept for at least 1 year and that no deletion occurred during the requested window.

maria (SecEng): We keep CloudTrail + KMS audit logs 13 months by default. HSM session logs retained 18 months. I will attach retention config exports.

taylor (Compliance): Also add the access review for principals who had Decrypt permissions on that key during the window. HR/identity snapshot for any service accounts (service-redwood-ingest) that show up in the events.

jess (PlatformOps): Pushed the IAM policy snapshot and principal list to the same evidence bundle. Link updated. Added a small CSV: principals.csv with columns principalId, role, lastAuth, source.

auditor_bot: One last ask: sampling methodology used when we pulled the bundle — describe how you selected events so we can assess representativeness (auditor wants deterministic sampling).

maria (SecEng): Sampling method: we exported all events for the keyId in the time window first. Then we removed redundant automatic retries (SDK retry events) by deduping on requestParameters.ciphertextHash + userIdentity.principalId + minute-timestamp. From the deduped set we took full export. We'll include the de-dupe script and the hash function used.

sam (Support): Putting the repro playbook + minimal test artifact in the bundle. Also noting that billing anomalies were observed for that hour (spike in KMS requests) — filing a follow-up with finance if auditor wants cost breakdown.

taylor (Compliance): Auditor — we expect to deliver the finalized evidence pack + sampling documentation by EOD tomorrow (2025-11-10). Is that timeline acceptable?

auditor_bot: EOD tomorrow works. Please ensure the bundle includes MD5/SHA256 checksums for all files and a signed manifest. Also provide contact for a short (15–20 min) call if we need clarifications.

jess (PlatformOps): Will do checksums and manifest signing. Ping me for the call: jess@redwood.internal — available 10:00–16:00 PST.

maria (SecEng): Added the de-dupe script and a brief readme to the bundle. Marking as ready for final review. :white_check_mark:

sam (Support): Note to self: follow up with finance and attach billing export if auditor asks.

auditor_bot: Closing for now — will re-open if we need additional artifacts after review. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
